records.title: NAS4RRAM: neural network architecture search for inference on RRAM-based accelerators
records.reason: The Springer abstract describes NAS4RRAM searching hardware-friendly networks while modeling RRAM noise, quantization and converter limits for inference accelerators, a concrete hardware/model co-design contribution.
records.abstract_evidence_excerpt: We propose a framework called NAS4RRAM to search for the optimal network on the given RRAM-based accelerator.

records.title: Streaming End-to-End ASR based on Blockwise Non-Autoregressive Models
records.reason: The arXiv abstract combines blockwise streaming with non-autoregressive Mask-CTC decoding and reports lower latency and faster inference than autoregressive attention ASR; the decoding method merits comparison with parallel LLM decoding.
records.abstract_evidence_excerpt: it can achieve a much faster inference speed compared to the AR attention-based models.
